new.s: To which period does the Painted Grey Ware of the Gangetic plain belong?
new.x: Painted Grey Ware is the pottery of the Later Vedic people in the upper Ganga basin, dated about 1000-600 BC.
new.angle: U0019 #8 Pottery type -> period (APPSC PYQ ydb9f47e8723)

new.s: Which of the following types of pottery was NOT used by the Later Vedic people?
new.x: NBPW began only around 600 BCE with the Mahajanapadas; Black Slipped Ware, Painted Grey Ware and Red Ware are Later Vedic wares.
new.angle: U0019 #1 Later Vedic pottery group (APPSC PYQ y36ee458903c)

new.s: Which Upanishad describes the Chandala as a person of despised birth?
new.x: The Chhandogya Upanishad refers to the Chandala as of despised birth; formal untouchability came later.

new.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Chhandogya Upanishad refers to the Chandala as a person of despised birth.
2. Untouchability took a formal shape already in the Rigvedic period.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statement 1 is true. Formal untouchability belongs to the post-Vedic Dharmasutra and Dharmashastra phase, not the Rigvedic period.

new.s: Which varna was the most powerful in Later Vedic society?
new.x: The Brahmanas, as priests and teachers, were the most powerful varna; the Kshatriyas came next as rulers and warriors.
new.angle: U0021 #2 Relative status of Brahmana and Kshatriya

new.s: Who among the following women debated with Yajnavalkya in the Brihadaranyaka Upanishad?
new.x: The Brihadaranyaka Upanishad records the debate of the woman scholar Gargi with Yajnavalkya.

new.s: In which sense does the word 'gotra' occur in the Rigveda?
o: Cow shelter or herd of cows
Descent from a common male ancestor
new.x: In the Rigveda, where the word first occurs, gotra means a cow shelter or herd of cows; the lineage sense came later.
new.angle: U0022 APPSC PYQ y883dc3c204e gotra -> first occurrence

new.s: In which subject do the Sulbasutras show the skill of the Vedic people?
new.x: The Sulbasutras deal with measuring and building altars; the Baudhayana Sulbasutra states the theorem of the right-angled triangle.
new.angle: U0022 APPSC PYQ y40f0236c5a5 Vedic Aryans -> proficiency in sciences

new.s: Which work on Sanskrit grammar was written by Panini?
new.x: Panini (c. 500 BCE) wrote the Ashtadhyayi; Nirukta is by Yaska, Mahabhashya by Patanjali and Varttika by Katyayana.

new.s:
Match the following:
List-I (Author)
A. Panini
B. Yaska
C. Katyayana
D. Patanjali
List-II (Work)
1. Mahabhashya
2. Ashtadhyayi
3. Varttika
4. Nirukta
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
new.x: Panini wrote the Ashtadhyayi, Yaska the Nirukta, Katyayana the Varttika on Panini, and Patanjali the Mahabhashya.

new.s: Which among the following is NOT one of the six orthodox schools of Indian philosophy?
new.x: Charvaka (Lokayata) is a nastika, materialist school; the six orthodox darshanas are Nyaya, Vaisheshika, Samkhya, Yoga, Purva Mimamsa and Vedanta.
new.angle: U0023 APPSC PYQ y080be85b369 odd-one-out among shad-darshanas

new.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Smriti is one of the six orthodox darshanas.
2. Nyaya and Vaisheshika form a pair among the six darshanas.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Smriti is a category of scripture, not a darshana; Nyaya-Vaisheshika is one of the three pairs of the six schools.
new.angle: U0023 APPSC PYQ y080be85b369 Smriti is not a darshana

new.s:
